messages.subject: withProgress works; Progress object doesn't
parts:
Hi, the progress bar feature is very cool. I'm using it two places. In one place, the code looks like this, and it works:

withProgress(message="Loading historical data...", value=0, {
        setProgress(.5)
        ret <- load_stuff_from_database() # takes a while
})

(I currently have no way to estimate progress in a SQL call, so I just set the bar to 1/2, which works well enough for now.)

In other place, I need to set up the progress bar in one function, then call the update inside a dplyr loop in another function. It looks like this:

ProcessData <- reactive({
  n <- length(unique(selected_dat()$id))
  message("processing ", n, " things")
  progress <- shiny::Progress$new(session, min=1, max=n)
  on.exit(progress$close())
  progress$set(message = 'Processing historical data', value=n/2) # not working?
  ProcessDataForReal(selected_dat(), progress=progress)
})

ProcessDataForReal <- function(dat, progress=NULL) {
  dat %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    do({
      if (!is.null(progress)) { progress$inc(amount=1) } # not working?
      data.frame(stuff_that_takes_a_while)
    }) 
}

What I see on the screen is the "processing historical data" message, but nothing on the progress bar. There's no error on the console. Both the set() and inc() functions are being called. Neither function seems to work at any point in time. n is hundreds to thousands.

What could be going wrong? Is there a way to debug this?

 -Harlan

Ack! This was broken. Winston just fixed it on GitHub, so devtools::install_github("rstudio/shiny") should fix it.

Thanks for the report!
